source_observations.text: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
